text: *The car hits a pothole, jerking the detective awake.*

Captain:
As long as you're ready to arrive at the scene, it's fine.

Detective:
(Damn it... I can't believe I fell asleep... I look so unprofessional.)

Detective:
(Ok, what did the case file say..?)

Detective:
(I think... shit, I can barely remember. I'm way more exhausted than I thought.)

Detective:
(I just need to get through this investigation...Just gotta-)
*Police car pulls up to the crime scene.
